messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അഹ് എന്താണെന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യമാണെന്ന് ഈ കാട്ടു കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ മരവനം ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Ahi | Interjection expressing lament | **അഹ്** | “Ah!” | OK | | quanto | Degree adverb “how …” | **എത്ര** | “how” / “how much” | OK | | a | Infinitive marker (to) | — (encoded in the suffix **‑ാൻ** of “പറയാൻ”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | dir | Verb “to tell” | **പറയാൻ** | “to tell” | OK | | qual | Interrogative “what” | **എന്താണെന്ന്** | “what … is” | OK | | era | Imperfect “was” | **എന്താണെന്ന്** | “what … is” (covers past) | OK | | è | Present “is” | **എന്താണെന്ന്** | “what … is” (covers present) | OK | | cosa | Noun “thing” | **കാര്യം** | “thing” | OK | | dura | Adjective “hard / difficult” | **കഠിനമായ** | “hard / difficult” | OK | | esta | Demonstrative “this” | **ഈ** | “this” | OK | | selva | Noun “forest / wood” | **കാട്ടു** (or **മരവനം**) | “forest / wood” | OK | | selvaggia | Adjective “wild” | — (not expressed) | — | **MISSING** | | e (1) | Coordinating conjunction “and” (linking selvaggia and aspra) | **യും** (as part of *കഠിനവും*) | “and” | OK | | aspra | Adjective “rough” | **കഠിനവും** (hard/rough) | “hard / rough” | OK | | e (2) | Coordinating conjunction “and” (linking aspra and forte) | **വുമായ** (as part of *സാന്ദ്രവുമായ*) | “and” | OK | | forte | Adjective “strong / dense” | **സാന്ദ്രവുമായ** | “dense” | OK | | che | Relative pronoun “which” | — (implicit in the relative clause) | — | UNNECESSARY | | nel | Preposition + article “in the” | **ചിന്തയിൽ** | “in thought” | OK | | pensier | Noun “thought” | **ചിന്ത** (within *ചിന്തയിൽ*) | “thought” | OK | | rinova | Verb “renews” | **പുതുക്കുന്നു** | “renews” | OK | | la | Definite article “the” | — (articles not used in Malayalam) | — | UNNECESSARY | | paura! | Noun “fear” (exclamatory) | **ഭയത്തെ!** | “fear!” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING**: **selvaggia** – the notion “wild” is not rendered in the Malayalam translation. - **UNNECESSARY** (source words omitted because Malayalam does not require them): **a**, **che**, **la**. - No **WRONG** or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected in the target rendering of the mapped items.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 4: - Original: Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura - Issue: none - Corrected: അഹ് എന്താണെന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യം
- Line 5: - Original: esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte - Issue: MISSING – the adjective “wild” (selvaggia) was not rendered - Corrected: ഈ വന്യവും കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ കാട്
- Line 6: - Original: che nel pensier rinova la paura! - Issue: none - Corrected: ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു!
``` അഹ് എന്താണെന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യം ഈ വന്യവും കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ കാട് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു! ```
